description: OIDC-Trusted IAM Role Carries Administrator-Like Policy (Review)
rationale: An IAM role has an OIDC federated trust relationship and an identity-based Allow statement consistent with broad administrative privileges. The graph cannot prove the federated subject can assume it or that all actions are effective; inspect trust, SCPs, boundaries, explicit Deny and deployment controls.
remediation: Limit federated workloads to separate, least-privilege roles and require strict OIDC trust claims for organization/repository/branch or Kubernetes service account. Validate effective permissions independently.
